## ✨ Features

 🔗 The share link is ready the moment you stop: the upload runs while you record.
 🎥 Record a tab, a window or your whole screen, with camera bubble and mic.
 💬 Viewers react with emoji and comment right on the video, and you see who watched.
 🖼 Annotated screenshots with arrows, text and blur, shared by the same kind of link.
 👥 Workspaces for your team, with public, workspace-only or private visibility.
 💸 Priced by storage for the whole team, never per seat.
 ☁️ Self-host on your own Cloudflare account, with sign-in limited to your company.
 🔓 Every feature ships in the open-source build.

Viewers see one continuous video • The controls sit in a small bar on the page, so you never have to switch tabs 🔗 SHARE WITH A LINK 🔗 • When you stop, your video opens in a new tab with the link ready to copy, even while the last few seconds are still uploading • Anyone can watch in their browser, with no account and nothing to install • Links to [...] Record your screen and camera, and share it with a link the moment you stop. CaptureFlow is an open-source screen recorder for Chrome. Some things are quicker to show than to type out, like a bug, a new feature, or the five steps it takes to set something up. Record it once and send the link. Whoever opens it watches right in their browser, without signing up or installing anything, and can leave a comment at the exact second they have a question.
